description: This file defines types, functions, and logic for managing Discord allow lists, channel configurations, and access control within a Discord integration module. It includes normalization, matching, and permission checking functions specific to Discord entities.

methods.name: normalizeDiscordAllowList
methods.description: Normalizes a list of Discord user or role identifiers, applying prefixes and slug normalization, returning an allow list object.

methods.name: normalizeDiscordSlug
methods.description: Converts a string into a normalized Discord slug by lowercasing, removing '#' prefix, replacing non-alphanumeric characters with hyphens, and trimming hyphens.

methods.name: allowListMatches
methods.description: Checks if a candidate user or role matches the provided Discord allow list, considering allowAll flag and optional name matching.

methods.name: resolveDiscordAllowListMatch
methods.description: Determines if a candidate matches the allow list and returns match details including source and key.

methods.name: resolveDiscordUserAllowed
methods.description: Checks if a user ID, name, or tag is allowed based on the allow list.

methods.name: resolveDiscordRoleAllowed
methods.description: Checks if a user's roles are allowed based on role allow list.

methods.name: resolveDiscordMemberAllowed
methods.description: Checks if a user with roles is allowed based on user and role allow lists.

methods.name: resolveDiscordMemberAccessState
methods.description: Determines if a member has access based on channel and guild configurations.

methods.name: resolveDiscordOwnerAllowFrom
methods.description: Returns the allow list key for a user if they are allowed as owner.

methods.name: resolveDiscordOwnerAccess
methods.description: Checks if a user is allowed as owner based on allow list and returns the list and boolean.

methods.name: resolveDiscordCommandAuthorized
methods.description: Determines if a command is authorized in a direct message context based on allow list.

methods.name: resolveDiscordGuildEntry
methods.description: Resolves guild entry data from guild object or ID, with fallback to entries map.

methods.name: resolveDiscordChannelConfig
methods.description: Resolves channel configuration for a specific channel ID or name within a guild.

methods.name: resolveDiscordChannelConfigWithFallback
methods.description: Resolves channel configuration with parent fallback and scope considerations.

methods.name: resolveDiscordShouldRequireMention
methods.description: Determines if a Discord message should require a mention based on context and config.

methods.name: isDiscordAutoThreadOwnedByBot
methods.description: Checks if a thread is auto-owned by the bot based on IDs.

methods.name: isDiscordGroupAllowedByPolicy
methods.description: Checks if a Discord group is allowed based on group policy and allowlist status.

methods.name: resolveGroupDmAllow
methods.description: Checks if a channel is allowed in a group DM based on allow list.

methods.name: shouldEmitDiscordReactionNotification
methods.description: Determines if a reaction notification should be emitted based on mode and access.
